forest.placement_code: case BI.SNOWF: if(r<.3) pine(x,y,z,R(.85,1.25),true); else if(r<.33) rock(x,y,z,'#dfe6ee',.8,1); break;

highlands.placement_code: case BI.HIGH: if(r<.07) bush(x,y,z,pick(['#7c8a63','#6f7d58','#8a9470']),R(.6,1),1); else if(r<.12) rock(x,y,z,pick(['#8d8d86','#7f7f78']),R(.7,1.6),1); else if(r<.14) flower(x,y,z,pick(['#b28ad9','#f0e68c'])); else if(r<.145) pine(x,y,z,.8,false); break;

jungle.placement_code: case BI.JUNGLE: if(f&F_CLEAR){ if(r<.08) rock(x,y,z,pick(['#7a7f73','#6b705f']),R(.8,1.6)); else if(r<.14) bush(x,y,z,'#2e7d32',.8); break; } if(r<.26) jtree(x,y,z); else if(r<.5) bush(x,y,z,pick(['#2e7d32','#1f6b2b','#3a8a3a']),R(.7,1.2)); else if(r<.56) flower(x,y,z,pick(['#ff5a5a','#ffb000'])); break;

swamp.placement_code: case BI.SWAMP: if(r<.1) mangrove(x,y,z); else if(r<.22) reeds(x,y,z); else if(r<.28) bush(x,y,z,'#5f7334',.8); break;

grove.placement_code: case BI.GROVE: if(r<.2) cherry(x,y,z); else if(r<.36) flower(x,y,z,pick(['#ff9ec7','#ffc4dd','#ffffff','#f57fb0'])); break;

grassland.placement_code: case BI.GRASS: { const copse=fbm(x*.13+20,z*.13)>.3; if(copse&&r<.3) oak(x,y,z,R(.85,1.1)); else if(!copse&&r<.008) oak(x,y,z); else if(r<.13) flower(x,y,z,pick(['#ffe14d','#ffffff','#fff3a6','#ffd23f'])); else if(r<.19) PB.add(x+R(-.3,.3),y,z+R(-.3,.3),.3,.5,.3,col('#7fbf4d')); break; }

delta.placement_code: case BI.BEACH: { const nearLand=[[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]].some(([a,c])=>inside(i+a,j+c)&&B[(j+c)*N+i+a]!==BI.OCEAN&&B[(j+c)*N+i+a]!==BI.BEACH); const islet=ISLETS.some(s=>Math.hypot(x-s[0],z-s[1])<s[2]); if(islet&&r<.18) palm(x,y,z); else if(z>0&&r<.05&&(nearLand||rnd()<.5)) palm(x,y,z); else if(r<.07) rock(x,y,z,'#b8ad96',R(.4,.8)); else if(r<.1) bush(x,y,z,'#6f9a4a',.6); break; }

desert.placement_code: case BI.DESERT: if(f&(F_MESA|F_WASH)){ if(r<.02) bush(x,y,z,'#a08a55',.6); break; } if(r<.04) cactus(x,y,z); else if(r<.06) bush(x,y,z,pick(['#a08a55','#8f7a48']),R(.5,.8)); else if(r<.07) rock(x,y,z,'#c9975a',R(.6,1.2)); break;

volcano.placement_code: case BI.VOLC: if(r<.025) deadTree(x,y,z); else if(r<.05) PB.add(x,y,z,.8,R(1,3),.8,col('#1e1a1a')); else if(r<.07) rock(x,y,z,'#3a3432',R(.6,1.2)); break;
